definitions.explanation: A vehicle designed for travel in outer space, either crewed or uncrewed. Used for both real spacecraft and fictional ones.

examples.japanese: {宇宙船|うちゅうせん}が{打|う}ち{上|あ}げられた。
{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}は{無事|ぶじ}に{地球|ちきゅう}に{帰還|きかん}した。
examples.english: The spacecraft returned safely to Earth.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}どものころ、いつか{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}に{乗|の}りたいと{思|おも}っていた。
examples.english: When I was a child, I dreamed of riding in a spaceship someday.

notes:
Composed of {宇宙|うちゅう} (outer space) + {船|せん} (vessel). Covers both real spacecraft (like those used by NASA or JAXA) and fictional spaceships in science fiction.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {宇宙船|うちゅうせん}を{打|う}ち{上|あ}げる: to launch a spacecraft
- {有人|ゆうじん}{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}: crewed spacecraft
- {無人|むじん}{宇宙船|うちゅうせん}: uncrewed spacecraft
- {宇宙船|うちゅうせん}に{搭乗|とうじょう}する: to board a spacecraft

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ロケット: rocket — the launch vehicle, not the crewed capsule
- {人工衛星|じんこうえいせい}: artificial satellite — orbits but does not carry people
- {宇宙|うちゅう}ステーション: space station — a permanent structure in orbit
